submission.justification:
Mixture-G3 with a 2 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 1.315 ns among all eligible candidates. This represents a 37.17% improvement over Mixture-G2 (2.093 ns at 2 mm gap). 

The analysis proceeded as follows:
1. Mixture-G1 was eliminated due to exceeding the GWP100 limit of 150 (hard environmental constraint)
2. Both Mixture-G2 and Mixture-G3 met the GWP100 requirement and were simulated at 1, 2, and 3 mm gaps
3. Mixture-G3 consistently outperformed Mixture-G2 across all gap sizes
4. For Mixture-G3, the 2 mm gap provided the optimal time resolution (1.315 ns), better than both 1 mm (1.405 ns) and 3 mm (1.557 ns)
5. Additional refinement simulations at 1.5 mm and 2.5 mm gaps confirmed that 2 mm remains optimal

The recommended configuration satisfies all constraints: eligible mixture candidate, GWP100 compliant, gas gap within 1-3 mm range, and delivers the best achievable time resolution.
